t: This Soudal Decorators Caulk is a high-quality acrylic dispersion sealant designed to fill gaps and cracks before decorating. Ideal for painters, decorators and DIYers preparing interior walls, skirting boards and architraves, this product provides a durable and flexible seal that prevents cracking. Solvent-free formula is ready to use from a standard cartridge and cures within twenty-four hours. Once fully dry, the white caulk can be easily painted or papered over to achieve a seamless, professional finish on any interior renovation project.
b: Fills Gaps & Cracks for Seamless Walls
Accepts Paint & Wallpaper Once Fully Cured
Formulated for Interior Sealing & Filling Tasks
Resists Cracking with Durable & Flexible Acrylic
Arrives Ready to Use in Handy Cartridges
Provides Solvent-Free Sealant for Safer Indoor Use
Offers Clean White Finish to Match Woodwork
